title: $500 Proof Ladder
oneLiner: Convert a zero-revenue side project into seven small paid-proof experiments, ranked by speed, reach, and evidence—not motivational tasks.
targetUser: Technical builders with launched side projects earning $0–$100/month.
keyUX: Choose a paid-proof target, drag seven experiments onto a 14-day ladder, log asks/deposits/refusals, then continue/pivot/kill.
